title: mutisia subulata var. gracilis
intro: Mutisia subulata var. gracilis, commonly known as the "Mountain Mutisia", is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Mutisia subulata var. gracilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. Research has identified the bioactive constituents present in the plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
